title: Composed local assignment
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions, and let $K$ be a natural number. Given a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with $K$ clauses, a Boolean word on the disjoint union of the $n$ input positions and the $m+K|S|$ composed-proof positions, and a seed of the original verifier, define a sign assignment on the $r+K$ local variables by reading the word at each coordinate’s composed address and converting that Boolean value to its sign in $\{ -1,1\}$; here $S$ is the verifier’s finite seed set.
